title: Verifika configuration
description: Configuration for verifika, the deterministic repository verification CLI. https://github.com/alexportelli12/verifika

$schema.description: JSON schema reference for editor support.

defaults.description: Run-wide defaults. Command-line flags override these.

concurrency.description: Maximum number of checks running at once. Default: half the CPU cores, between 1 and 4.

timeoutMs.description: Default per-check timeout in milliseconds. A check that exceeds it is killed and fails. Default: 600000 (10 minutes).

failFast.description: Stop all checks after the first failure. Default: false (run every selected check and report all failures).

keepRuns.description: Number of recent runs whose logs are kept under .verifika/runs. Default: 10.

changes.description: How changed files are detected for selective runs.

base.description: Git ref to compare against for selective runs. Files changed since merge-base(base, HEAD), plus uncommitted and untracked files, are considered changed. Default: "HEAD" (only uncommitted work).

invalidateAll.description: Glob patterns; if any changed file matches, every check runs. verifika.config.json is always included.

checks.description: Checks keyed by name. Names may contain letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-'.

globs.description: Glob patterns relative to the config directory, using forward slashes. Supports *, **, ?, [abc] and {a,b}. Matching is case-sensitive and includes dotfiles.

command.description: Shell command to run from the config directory (sh on POSIX, cmd.exe on Windows). Exit code 0 means the check passed.

paths.description: Run this check only when a changed file matches one of these globs. Omit to run it whenever any file changed.

exclude.description: Changed files matching these globs never select this check.

always.description: Run this check on every run, even when nothing changed. Cannot be combined with paths or exclude.

dependsOn.description: Checks that must pass before this one starts. Selecting this check also selects them.

timeoutMs.description: Timeout for this check in milliseconds, overriding defaults.timeoutMs.
